purpose: Teach: 変態/下痢/淘汰/封鎖/犯す/駆除/悟り/生ずる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場の変態的な動きに対応しろ
lines.en: The market is moving in unpredictable ways. We need to adapt quickly.
lines.style: Steady, commanding tone. Open with controlled intensity. Each phrase lands with weight. No hesitation—this is a leader laying out facts and expectation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の食中毒下痢には十分注意しております
lines.en: Yes. We're being very careful to monitor the situation closely.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Lean into the deference without sounding defeated. Clear enunciation. Show you're taking it seriously through steady delivery, not panic.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合の淘汰が進んでいる、当社にもチャンスだ
lines.en: Competitors are being eliminated from the market. This is our opportunity.
lines.style: Firm conviction. Slight pause before 'opportunity'—let it land as recognition, not greed. Cold clarity underneath. The voice of someone who sees the board clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場の一時封鎖の影響を最小化しております
lines.en: Yes. We're minimizing the impact of the temporary factory closure.
lines.style: Professional update. Clipped, efficient. Not emotional—just reporting progress. Voice stays level and competent. Shows he's already handling it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員が法を犯すような行為は絶対許さない
lines.en: Under no circumstances will I tolerate staff breaking the law.
lines.style: Sharp, non-negotiable tone. Hard attack on the opening. Lower register, slower pace. This is a line drawn. No softness. The kind of statement that makes the room go quiet.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内害虫の駆除を業者に依頼しました
lines.en: Yes. We've already contracted with a specialist to handle the issue.
lines.style: Quick affirmation. Efficient. Show that you've already anticipated and acted. No apology in the voice—just clear completion of a task. Steady hand.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、商売の悟りを社員に伝えろ
lines.en: I want our staff to understand the deeper purpose behind what we do.
lines.style: Reflective but still commanding. Soften slightly from the earlier intensity—this is philosophy, not decree. Thoughtful pace. A moment of genuine conviction underneath the authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。クレームから生ずる学びも大切にしております
lines.en: Yes. We treat every customer complaint as an opportunity to learn and improve.
lines.style: Closing agreement with subtle warmth. Earnest tone—show that Kenji believes this, that it's not just corporate speak. Slight lift at the end. The real philosophy beneath the protocol.
